description: Implementation of PersistentStore plugin for WPEFramework, managing a SQLite database with encryption support, providing methods for key-value storage, namespace management, and size monitoring.

classes.name: PersistentStore
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing persistent key-value storage with SQLite, supporting encryption, namespace management, and event notifications.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the SQLite database, creates tables, and sets up encryption if needed.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair within a specified namespace, managing size constraints.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value for a given key within a namespace.

methods.name: deleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a specific key from a namespace.

methods.name: deleteNamespace
methods.description: Removes an entire namespace and its associated data.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Lists all keys within a namespace.

methods.name: vacuum
methods.description: Performs database vacuuming to optimize storage.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up the plugin, creates necessary directories and database.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources when plugin is deactivated.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information as JSON string.
